newsitem.title: ITALY: New Italian airline to start at end March.
newsitem.headline: New Italian airline to start at end March.

text.p: A new Italian airline, Phoenix Linee Aeree, said it will begin commence operations at the end of March with passenger scheduled and charter flights to Amsterdam. Frankfurt, Madrid, Dublin, Athens, London and six Italian destinations.
It said it will begin operating with one aircraft that will be joined by another two by the end of the first operational year.
Phoenix's operating base will be Pisa's Galileo Galilei airport. It said it has 35 employees recruited from other airline companies.
A market survey is currently in progress and once completed a cargo service could begin in about two years' time, said a Phoenix source.
